name: email-input
title: Email Input
description: Spots misspelled domains like gmial.con or rediffmial.com with Damerau-Levenshtein matching and offers a one-tap, never automatic, fix; can suggest matching providers while the domain is being typed.

meta.summary: Spots misspelled email domains like gmial.con and offers a one-tap fix, never an automatic one, so sign-ups don't bounce.
meta.server: Verify ownership with a confirmation email before relying on the address.
catches: Typos avoided altogether, with provider completions while typing (completeDomains)
limits: Only knows the domains in its list; a typo of an unlisted domain isn't caught
It doesn't check that the mailbox exists
a11y: With completions on: role="combobox", a role="listbox", aria-activedescendant and arrow, Enter/Tab and Escape keys
Fix returns focus to the input; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion
